title: SNL Features GTA 6's Jason and Link in New Skit
description: Saturday Night Live recently featured a Weekend Update skit bringing together GTA 6 protagonist Jason and Link from The Legend of Zelda.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## SNL Takes on GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda

Popular late-night comedy show Saturday Night Live (SNL) recently turned its satirical lens toward the gaming industry, featuring a unique Weekend Update skit that caught the attention of gamers worldwide. The segment drew comparisons between Rockstar Games' highly anticipated open-world blockbuster GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda, specifically touching on discussions surrounding a potential Ocarina of Time remake.

## A Crossover of Iconic Protagonists

According to media reports, the highlight of the skit was the inclusion of virtual protagonists. The sketch featured GTA 6 male lead Jason Duval alongside Nintendo's legendary hero, Link. Pitting the gritty, modern open-world criminal against the classic fantasy adventurer created an instant comedic contrast, quickly sparking conversations across online gaming communities and social media platforms.

## Gaming Culture in Mainstream Media

It is not every day that specific upcoming video game characters become the focal point of mainstream late-night sketch comedy. As one of the most anticipated entertainment releases in history, GTA 6 continues to command massive cultural relevance, bridging the gap between traditional media and modern interactive entertainment in unexpected ways.

## Editor's Take

Seeing Jason alongside Link on a stage like SNL highlights just how deeply entrenched GTA 6 is in mainstream pop culture even before its release. While the skit was purely for comedic effect, it underscores the massive cultural footprint of both Rockstar's franchise and Nintendo's timeless series.
